what: pohunek-sessiond cold release build without and with libghostty-vt linked into TerminalTracker

measurement_branch.name: 2538-s6s7-sessiond-measure-local-only
measurement_branch.change: crates/terminal gains an opt-in feature that links libghostty-vt: the spike's ffi.rs and ghostty.rs are copied in, TerminalTracker feeds a headless libghostty terminal instead of a vt100 parser, and snapshot() reads the visible text and the repaint from the libghostty formatters. vt100 stays linked because Compositor and ScreenTracker still use it.

command: cargo build --release --target TARGET -p pohunek-session-worker --bin pohunek-sessiond [--features ghostty-measure], fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR, strip
